PluginData.Author: Garbius
PluginData.Tooltip: Native support for the Wooting analog keyboards.
PluginData.Description:
Adds support for analog control of the character, space ships, and rovers in singleplayer and multiplayer games. It also affects programmable blocks, where the values can be accessed through IMyShipController.MoveIndicator as normal but the values are much more analog. The controls can be set as usual in the game options.
Requires the Wooting Analog SDK. On Windows it is installed together with Wootility.
There is an issue with wheels and analog controls. The brakes and throttle are treated as digital (on/off), affecting the Wooting and other controllers alike. Another plugin, Analog Wheel Control (SEAnalogWheels), addresses this issue until Keen fixes it.
